name: Splitr
tagline: Splits shared bills fairly, with a demo that uses face recognition to log who is using a device.

awards: MLH - Best Use of Auth0 || Wireless Headphones

problem: Roommates run up shared bills unevenly.
solution: An expense splitter plus time-based usage tracking, with local face recognition to attribute usage and Auth0 login.
demo_moment: Team-described: the camera logs who is at the console.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH - Best Use of Auth0 || Wireless Headphones” among 122 submissions.

lessons: A relatable roommate fight makes a utility pitch land.
